theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) blended with Top-Tier SaaS (Linear/Vercel aesthetic)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Authority, precision, clarity, high-end finance. Think Bloomberg Terminal redesigned by an elite architecture studio. No generic crypto-purple-on-black.

fonts_to_install: Cabinet Grotesk (Headings - import via fontshare or CDN)

hierarchy.h1: font-sans text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-white
hierarchy.h2: font-sans text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white
hierarchy.h3: font-sans text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white
hierarchy.overline_labels: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#71717A] font-semibold

rules: NEVER use generic fonts for Headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for its sharp, wide, technical feel.
ALL numbers, APYs, and metric data MUST use JetBrains Mono or a monospaced font to align vertically in tables.
Headlines MUST use tracking-tighter. Do not use bold (700+) excessively; rely on medium (500) with tight tracking for a premium feel.
NO PURPLE/TEAL GRADIENTS. Use solid, deep obsidian backgrounds with razor-thin borders.
The primary accent is Signal Orange (#FF4500). Use it SPARINGLY (e.g., active states, CTA buttons, chart highlights) to create maximum contrast and tension.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for text/surfaces. Use off-whites (#F4F4F5) and tinted darks (#050505).

landing_page.alignment: Asymmetrical layouts. Break out of generic center-aligned blocks.
landing_page.hero_structure: Left-aligned massive typography, right-side 3D abstract visual or dashboard preview.

dashboard_app.spacing: Tight, dense spacing (p-4, gap-4). Every pixel matters.
dashboard_app.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align tables and labels.
dashboard_app.structure: Sidebar navigation + top utility bar. Dashboard area is border-collapsed (grid items share borders).

radii.landing: rounded-2xl for main bento cards, rounded-full for buttons
radii.dashboard: rounded-lg for widgets, rounded-md for inner elements

surfaces_and_micro_themes.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-white/5. MUST stay readable.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat solid background (#0A0A0A) with a sharp 1px inner stroke (ring-1 ring-white/10). NO soft shadows in dark mode. Use subtle glow (drop-shadow) for active items.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons_primary: bg-[#FF4500] text-white hover:bg-[#E63E00] transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons_secondary: bg-transparent text-white ring-1 ring-white/20 hover:ring-white/50 hover:bg-white/5 transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-2

components_strategy.marketing_pages: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Shadcn only for complex forms/inputs. Heavily customize standard patterns.
components_strategy.dashboard_pages: Use Shadcn UI (Tables, Badges, Dropdowns, Tabs, Dialogs) but strip out default Vercel aesthetic. Make borders darker, text sharper.
components_strategy.badges: For 'Beginner Safe' tags, use ring-1 ring-[#00E599]/30 bg-[#00E599]/10 text-[#00E599]. For Risk Tiers, use appropriate colors (Orange/Red) with the same pattern.
components_strategy.tables: Yield opportunities table MUST use monospace fonts for APY and TVL columns. Align numbers to the right. Give the table a sleek, border-collapsed tech look.

libraries: framer-motion (Page transitions, list staggering, bento grid reveals)
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) with spring physics. Apply to external page navigation.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements MUST have explicit hover text and background colors. Elements should slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) if they are cards.
motion_and_interactions.alerts_animation: When a user adds an alert, use a Sonner toast notification with a subtle entering animation.

rules: NEVER use generic placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the URLs provided below.
If using an image as a background, apply a gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] to-transparent) so text remains readable.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark geometric nodes for hero section background or bento grid visual. Add a heavy dark overlay.

dashboard_preview.description: Dark 3D cube visual to use as a placeholder for a 'How it works' or Data node section.

testing_attributes.requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion @phosphor-icons/react @studio-freight/lenis clsx tailwind-merge`.
In tailwind.config.js, extend colors with the specific hex codes provided in the colors section.
Build the Landing Page in pure HTML/Tailwind. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered reveals on the 'How it works' and Feature Bento Grid.
Build the Dashboard (/dashboard) with a sidebar and top header. The main area should be tightly packed.
Yield Table: Sortable by APY, filterable by chain/asset. Include 'Beginner Safe' tags prominently.
Include a 'Watchlist' view and an 'Alerts' management view where users set threshold notifications.
Wrap page changes in Framer Motion `<AnimatePresence>` for smooth layout transitions.
Maintain the Top-Tier SaaS look: No clutter, heavy reliance on negative space around groups, stark contrast, and absolute precision.
